note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The scope is documented and the outstanding documents are recorded before work is set.
The primary duty covers workers and others affected by the work, so far as is reasonably practicable.

practicalCriteria: The learner separates the three documents and names the outstanding ones.
The learner refuses to start work without a named approver and written limits.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: Any of the three documents is missing for the activity proposed.
No site controller or approver is named.
